basic_info.description: Spacious 1BR + Den at the iconic LINEA in Hayes Valley which was designed by Award-winnig architect Bernard Fort-Brescia of Arquitectonica. This home is highlighted with a modern open floorplan, hardwood floors & dramatic southeast-facing double-pane windows. The den offers a versatile are to serve as a comfortable work from home space or guest quarters.  Sleek designer kitchen features European stainless steel appliances, Italian cabinetry & quartz countertops. Convenient in-unit stacked washer/dryer, two walk-in closets & custom window coverings. Dual-zone radiant heating in both living room and bedroom. This well-maintained building has  amenities including: a full time lobby attendant, bike storage & a rooftop terrace w/expansive views of the City. Whole Foods, Bart/Muni & tech shuttle stops are all easily accessible. Minutes to some of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods including Hayes Valley, Mission, Duboce Triangle & The Castro.
